categorization.name: Email Categorization
categorization.template:
Analyze the following email and categorize it into ONE of these categories: Important, Newsletter, Spam, or To-Do.

Rules:
- Important: Emails requiring awareness but no immediate action
- To-Do: Emails with explicit action requests or tasks
- Newsletter: Marketing, updates, or promotional content
- Spam: Unsolicited or suspicious emails

Email:
From: {from}
Subject: {subject}
Body: {body}

Respond with ONLY the category name (Important/Newsletter/Spam/To-Do).

auto_reply.name: Auto-Reply Draft
auto_reply.template:
Draft a professional email reply based on the context below.

Original Email:
From: {from}
Subject: {subject}
Body: {body}

Guidelines:
- For meeting requests: Ask for agenda and confirm availability
- For task requests: Acknowledge and provide estimated timeline
- For questions: Provide helpful response or redirect
- Use a friendly yet professional tone

Generate ONLY the reply body text.
